name: GEO spin-stabilised weather satellite (MSG / Fengyun-2 class)
note: Generic spinning GEO weather drum (Meteosat Second Generation, Fengyun-2), written by tools/make_geo_models.py. The drum spins at 100 rpm about the north-south axis; photometrically it is a cylinder of cells, so the spin is not modelled. Body frame: +Z nadir, +X velocity, +Y south.

sources.subject: drum
sources.value: 3.2 m diameter, 2.4 m tall drum of body-mounted cells
sources.source: EUMETSAT, 'Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) design': cylindrical, 3.2 m diameter, 2.4 m high, spin-stabilised at 100 rpm, solar cells on the cylindrical surface; Fengyun-2 is similar (2.1 m x 1.6 m drum).

sources.value: MLI-covered end platforms (drawn; photometrically the drum's caps, which are cells)
sources.source: MSG photographs; size from the drum.

sources.subject: bus
sources.value: spin axis parallel to the Earth's axis
sources.source: EUMETSAT MSG design: spin axis north-south; the spin is not modelled (axisymmetric drum).

sources.value: class liveries and the presets' reflectance
sources.source: Liveries from published on-orbit / factory photographs of the classes (gold or amber MLI on the bus, silver OSR radiator panels on the north and south faces, white-painted reflectors, blue-black cells under cover glass); reflectance from the presets.
